name: Aybek Arvidsson-Sesay
role: Personal security and threat neutralization — bodyguard
location: The Spires — mid-level corporate residential towers, near Lake Shore Drive and Division
description:
Aybek Arvidsson-Sesay is broad-shouldered and heavy, carrying their weight like armor rather than burden. At 65, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — eye replacement — one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He came up through the Shelf's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see him surpass them. He works as a bodyguard out of The Spires, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Aybek Arvidsson-Sesay describe him as a precision instrument — point him at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
core_desires: Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
psychology.secret: Aybek Arvidsson-Sesay has a terminal condition — geneware degradation — with an estimated five years. They haven't changed their lifestyle. They haven't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Halting — speaks in fragments, reassembles thoughts in real time.
verbal_tics: Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
example_lines: "You're paying me to be the thing between you and everything else. Stay behind me."
"I don't protect people I don't respect. Lucky for you, I respect your money."
"The threat you see isn't the one that kills you. Watch my eyes, not my hands."

story_hooks: Aybek Arvidsson-Sesay intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Aybek Arvidsson-Sesay's reputation — and a price for silence
A corporate black site Aybek Arvidsson-Sesay once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
narrative_function: Aybek Arvidsson-Sesay is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When he makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of his stories.
augmentations: Eye replacement — one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom. Eye replacement — one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Independent — maintains network of professional contacts

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
breaking_points: Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and heavy-set, with dense muscle mass beneath a layer of middle-aged weight distribution. Carries his frame with the controlled balance of someone who knows exactly how much force he contains.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with hints of dark brown at the roots
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: dark brown, natural. Right eye: matte gunmetal chrome with faint amber lens-flare beneath the surface
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep tan with warm undertones, weathered from 65 years of living
physical_description.complexion: Strong jawline, broad nose, deep-set eye sockets. Skin shows age gracefully — fine lines around the mouth and temples, minimal scarring on the face itself. Close-shaved jaw, minimal facial hair. No vanity in grooming, only maintenance.
distinguishing_marks: Faint white scar running three inches down the left side of his neck, partially hidden by the collar line
Burn scarring on the inside of his right forearm — old, pale, consistent with industrial heat exposure
Small tattoo on the inside of left wrist: a single vertical line with three horizontal marks crossing it — utilitarian, not decorative
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right eye is unmistakably cybernetic — matte chrome casing with a faintly visible aperture mechanism and amber-tinted optical sensor. No effort to conceal it. The augmentation is professional-grade, industrial aesthetic. Suggests additional augmentation beneath clothing that isn't immediately visible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight evenly distributed, never off-balance. Moves with deliberate economy — no wasted motion, no nervous gestures. Eyes track people and exits constantly, habit made instinct. When stationary, he creates an impression of coiled potential rather than relaxation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Mid-tier Spires resident wearing quality without ostentation: charcoal wool blazer, dark neutral underlayers, tailored but not form-fitting. Custom-fitted jacket with subtle reinforcement panels at the shoulders. Expensive boots broken in from real use, not display. No logos, no flash, no jewelry. Dresses like someone who needs to move quickly and be forgettable.
